name: Broccoli
bestUse: Soups, stir-fries, casseroles, and side dishes
tip: Cool completely and dry well before packing.

name: Green Beans
bestUse: Side dishes, soups, and skillet meals
tip: Cut into smaller pieces before freezing if you want faster cooking later.

name: Cauliflower
prep: Cut into florets and blanch before freezing
bestUse: Roasted sides, soups, mash, and casseroles
tip: Freeze in a single layer first to prevent large clumps.

name: Bell Peppers
tip: They soften after freezing, so they are best for cooked meals.

name: Onions
bestUse: Soups, sauces, eggs, and cooked meals
tip: Freeze flat in bags so you can break off small amounts.

name: Carrots
bestUse: Soups, stews, fried rice, and side dishes
tip: Blanching helps keep color and texture better.

name: Chicken Breast
prep: Portion with marinade or cook before freezing
bestUse: Bowls, tacos, salads, pasta, and quick dinners
tip: Freeze portions flat so they thaw faster.

name: Ground Beef
prep: Freeze raw in portions or cook before freezing
bestUse: Tacos, pasta, rice bowls, and casseroles
tip: Flatten the bag before freezing to save space.

name: Salmon
prep: Portion and wrap tightly before freezing
bestUse: Rice bowls, salads, and dinner plates
tip: Use airtight wrapping to reduce freezer burn.

name: Pork Tenderloin
prep: Slice or portion with seasoning before freezing
bestUse: Rice bowls, roasted meals, and sandwiches
tip: Label the marinade flavor before freezing.

name: Blueberries
prep: Wash, dry, and freeze in a single layer
tip: Dry them well before freezing to prevent ice crystals.

name: Bananas
tip: Freeze ripe bananas when they are sweet and soft.

name: Strawberries
prep: Remove tops, slice, and freeze in a single layer
bestUse: Smoothies, yogurt bowls, sauces, and desserts
tip: Freeze on a tray first so the pieces stay separate.

name: Cooked Rice
prep: Cook, cool quickly, and freeze in portions
bestUse: Rice bowls, fried rice, soups, and quick sides
tip: Freeze in thin portions for faster reheating.

name: Cooked Beans
prep: Cook, cool, and freeze with a little liquid
bestUse: Soups, bowls, burritos, and side dishes
tip: A little cooking liquid helps prevent the beans from drying out.
